title: rosa woodsii var. neomexicana
intro:
Rosa woodsii var. neomexicana, commonly known as New Mexico Rose, is a variety of the Woods' Rose plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. As a medicinal plant, it has been traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa woodsii var. neomexicana include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing due to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
